text:
anna: Heads-up — seeing a spike in fncall validation failures in prod. ~7% of calls to the payment_tool now failing schema check in the last hour. dashboard: https://console/redwood/d/route/payment_tool/errors :eyes:

mike: Yep saw that. Looks like a model variant started emitting arrays for `items` instead of the object we expect. Sample: `[{\"id\":123,\"qty\":1}]` vs expected `{\"items\":[{...}]}`.

riyad: Thinking routing policy: if validator rejects, we could fall back to a text-only endpoint (raw JSON string) and run a lightweight shim to coerce into the typed shape. Mark the request as "degraded" and continue, to avoid 503s.

sam (pm): We need to be careful — customers expect typed outputs. Silent degrade could cause subtle product bugs. If we do this we must expose a clear indicator in the Console and ensure billing/quota semantics are sane.

lucy: Agreed on visibility. Proposal: add a per-route "degradation" column in the route table, plus a small sampled payload list (first 10 per hour) with redaction applied. Also add a rollout toggle so degen only enabled on canary slices.

mike: rough validator pseudocode:```
try:
  parsed = json.parse(response)
  assert matches_schema(parsed)
except ValidationError as e:
  emit_metric('fncall.validation.fail', kind=e.code)
  fallback = call_raw_model(request.prompt)  # text-only path
  coerced = shim.coerce(fallback)
  mark_degraded()
  return coerced
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary at 11:15 :shipit: (canary flag: fncall.degen=true)

anna: Telemetry notes: we must record `original_error_kind`, `validator_hash` (to group new failure classes), and `fallback_success` boolean (did shim produce parseable shape). Also correlate with trace id so we can bisection. For billing, only charge tokens consumed by the final model that produced the output.

riyad: On sampling: watch PII. Courts of payloads need redaction before storing. Suggest these redaction rules: keys named `ssn`, `card_number`, and values matching regex for emails/phones must be dropped. Log only shape + non-sensitive examples.

lucy: I'll add a console banner and a toggle in the route settings. Metrics to add: `fncall.degen.rate`, `fncall.validation.fail_rate`, `fncall.fallback.success_rate`. Alert if `degen.rate > 1%` for >15m. I'll make a PR for the dashboard panels.

sam (pm): Priority looks medium-high. Can we get a short customer-facing blurb for status page if this persists? Also need an internal playbook: when to disable degen and force strict rejects.

anna: I'll draft the SDK fallback PR + docs for rollout and the internal playbook. Will include exact metric names and the redaction whitelist. cc @lucy @riyad for dashboard/telemetry hooks. :+1:
